key_insight: HISPO improves RLVR for mathematical reasoning by assigning credit at an intermediate segment level, using entropy-derived contiguous segments with soft saliency weights and clipped importance sampling.
engineering_relevance: For engineers building reasoning models, HISPO offers a practical granularity between token-level and sequence-level updates that can better handle long-form credit assignment in training.
method: Split each rollout into contiguous segments based on entropy.
Weight segments with soft entropy-derived saliency scores.
Apply clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment level.
evidence_signal: The authors fine-tuned Qwen3-1.7B-Base and report gains across six math benchmarks, with HISPO improving AIME25 by +3.75 Acc@8 and +3.78 Pass@8 over GRPO.
watch_item: Entropy-based segmenting adds extra design choices and may be sensitive to segmentation quality or training stability in longer completions.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
